purpose: rev0336 surface contracts: current mission, compact navigation, owner rail, field handoff bundle, source-result-linked teacher/tutor micro-pilot follow-through, and no-real-evidence boundaries must not drift.
source_of_truth_rule: SURFACES.json remains the comprehensive generated map; CUBE_SURFACE_CONTRACTS.json constrains canonical rows whose generated type, lifecycle, owner, authority, portability, quality, evidence markers, or tags must not drift silently.
coverage_rules: Contracted rows must exist in SURFACES.json and on disk.
Contracted rows must match expected type, lifecycle, owner, authority, portability, and classification quality.
Required evidence levels and tags must be present; forbidden tags must be absent.
Meta, audit, and re-entry contracts must not carry branch_archive lifecycle or branch-archive tags.
SURFACES.json now separates primary_tags from mentioned_tags while preserving tags as a backward-compatible union.
Surface metadata contracts, tag hygiene, and sprint planning do not close FT-0181 and do not prove service effectiveness.
Executable CSV triage tools may enforce intake routing but do not close FT-0181 or prove service effectiveness.
Field-texture capture, public-outcome kernels, and branch-tail freeze audits do not close FT-0181 and do not prove service effectiveness.
Send-now brief, field-texture capture, public-outcome kernels, risk-burndown audits, and branch-tail freeze audits do not close FT-0181 and do not prove service effectiveness.
Route-block audits and tools may record a no-send local block but must not carry branch_archive lifecycle, owner evidence, contact-clock, closure, or public-claim tags.
Reask-log audits and tools may record a bounded clarification local block but must not carry branch_archive lifecycle, owner evidence, closure, or public-claim tags.

Source-packet lineage activation gate surfaces must not treat SRC2-CANDIDATE-NOT-ACCEPTED, ready_for_real_packet, or an activation receipt as public evidence, custody, closure, or public-claim support.
Activation receipt surfaces may gate active_change ticketing only; they do not close FT-0181 and do not prove service effectiveness.

Live-window terminal-state brief surfaces may compress staged/active card handoff to terminal card command skeletons only; they do not record terminal cards, readouts, service-record changes, public claims, custody, acceptance, lifecycle moves, or FT-0181 closure.

Live-window readout brief surfaces may compress terminal-readout-to-post-readout-action handoff only; they do not record readouts, dispatch post-readout actions, mutate service records, support public claims, create custody/acceptance, move lifecycle state, or close FT-0181.
